## Overview
### Introduction to Gemini 2.5 Flash
The Gemini 2.5 Flash model, released by Google on 2025-03-25, is a standard, non-open-source AI model designed for a variety of tasks. Its architecture supports a context window of up to 1,048,576 tokens and can generate outputs of up to 65,536 tokens. With a knowledge cutoff of 2025-01, Gemini 2.5 Flash is well-suited for tasks that require extensive context understanding and complex output generation.

### Technical Capabilities and Pricing
Gemini 2.5 Flash boasts an impressive array of capabilities, including text and vision processing, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, system prompts, extended thinking, and audio processing. Its strengths are reflected in its benchmark scores: 89.0 on MMLU and HumanEval, 1330 on LMSYS Arena ELO, and 97.0 on GSM8K. The model is priced at $0.3 per 1M tokens for input, $2.5 per 1M tokens for output, and $0.03 per 1M tokens for cached input. Notably, batch input is not charged. This pricing structure makes Gemini 2.5 Flash a competitive option for tasks such as coding, analysis, and vision tasks, with cost examples including $0.375 for 1,000 calls (avg 500 tokens) and $37.5 for 100,000 calls.

### Use Cases and Competitors
Gemini 2.5 Flash is best suited for complex tasks that require extensive context understanding, such as coding, analysis, and vision tasks. It is not recommended for simple classification, embeddings, or bulk cheap tasks.
